title: BIO-ROBOTS
en: Even machines died here within minutes. Then they sent people.
September 1986. Chernobyl, the roof of Unit 3.
Graphite blown out by the explosion lay scattered here.
The radiation was so strong it burned out the robots' circuits.
So soldiers were sent in. They were called bio-robots.
Lead sheets, home-made armour, and a shovel in hand.
Each man had just 90 seconds. Throw the debris, and run.
About 4,000 people went up onto this roof.
By November, a concrete tomb stood over the reactor.
Many of them stayed ill for the rest of their lives.
